build_tokenizer: build a tokenizer using build_tokenizer with name bytes sp tiktoken or mock and an optional model path
encode_text_byte: encode text to byte tokens using ByteTokenizer encode with optional BOS and EOS token flags
decode_tokens_byte: decode a list of integer tokens back to a UTF-8 string using ByteTokenizer decode
encode_text_sentencepiece: encode text to tokens using SentencePieceTokenizer with a SentencePiece model file and BOS EOS flags
get_token_offsets: get token substrings and their byte offsets in the original text using get_token_offsets on any tokenizer
